<div class="card-body">
'''Grand Moff Tarkin''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">グランドモフ・ターキン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ベイダーと同じ戦闘に参加していれば、敵が運命数を求めて見せた後で、1枚だけキャンセルすることができる。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力+2になる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Grand-Moff-Tarkin-Encyclopedia32-original.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja"><u>リーダー</u>。アウターリムの統治者。デス・スター司令官。帝国元老院の解散に功があった。恐怖統治の原則を打ち立てたデス・スターを、皇帝への謀反に使おうと画策していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Grand Moff Tarkin

'''Card text:''' If participating in the same battle as Vader, may cancel just one card after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny. A starship he pilots gets power +2.

'''Lore:''' Leader. Governor of the Outer Rim. Death Star commander. Played a part in dissolving the Imperial Senate. He was plotting to use the Death Star, which established the principle of rule through fear, in a rebellion against the Emperor.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
